feature: Call-audio source: input device or all system audio
description: The call-audio picker in Settings → Recording offers None, All system audio, or an input device; device sources are captured by a second session and mixed with the mic, and a missing device never stops the recording.

specs.description: Picker offers None, All system audio and input devices, defaulting to None
specs.given: macOS lists audio inputs 'MacBook Mic' and 'BlackHole 2ch', and no call-audio choice has been stored
specs.when: the call-audio picker options are built
specs.then: the options are None, All system audio, 'MacBook Mic' and 'BlackHole 2ch'; the selected value is None

specs.description: The microphone device is not offered a second time
specs.given: inputs 'MacBook Mic', 'BlackHole 2ch' and 'Loopback' exist and 'MacBook Mic' is chosen as the microphone
specs.when: the call-audio picker options are built
specs.then: the device options are 'BlackHole 2ch' and 'Loopback' only; 'MacBook Mic' appears once at most, as the microphone and not in the call-audio list

specs.description: No 'One app' choice or running-app list exists
specs.given: several regular apps (e.g. Safari, Zoom) are running
specs.when: the call-audio picker options are built
specs.then: no option refers to an app or 'One app'; the running apps are not listed

specs.description: Options are always None, All system audio, then every input except the mic
specs.given: any set of audio input devices and any microphone choice (or none)
specs.then: the options are exactly None, All system audio, plus each listed input device other than the microphone, with no duplicates and no app entries

specs.description: Changing the microphone to the device previously chosen as call audio removes it from the list
specs.given: call-audio choice is 'BlackHole 2ch' and the microphone is 'MacBook Mic'
specs.when: the user selects 'BlackHole 2ch' as the microphone
specs.then: 'BlackHole 2ch' is no longer offered as a call-audio device and the stored call-audio choice does not silently capture the same device twice

specs.description: The call-audio row sits directly under Microphone in the Recording card
specs.given: the Settings Recording card layout
specs.when: the rows are listed in order
specs.then: the call-audio row is immediately after the Microphone row, in the Recording card, and no separate call-audio section exists

specs.description: Permission row appears only for All system audio
specs.given: the call-audio choice is All system audio and System Audio Recording permission is not granted
specs.then: a permission row appears under the call-audio row

specs.description: No permission row for None or an input device
specs.given: the choice is None, or the choice is an input device such as 'BlackHole 2ch'
specs.then: no System Audio permission row appears

specs.description: A device source starts and stops with Record and is mixed into one 16 kHz mono WAV
specs.given: call-audio choice is 'BlackHole 2ch' and the microphone is working
specs.when: Record is pressed and later stopped
specs.then: a second capture session for the device starts on Record and stops on Stop, and one 16 kHz mono WAV is produced containing the mic mixed with the device audio

specs.description: A device source does not request System Audio Recording permission
specs.given: choice is an input device and System Audio Recording permission is not granted
specs.then: recording starts with the device source and System Audio Recording permission is never requested

specs.description: Remote voice is not doubled in the mix, same rule as the tap
specs.given: any microphone signal and any device signal in which the remote voice also leaks into the microphone
specs.then: the result follows the same mixing rule as the tap (ADR-2611240900 §3): one mono 16 kHz output and the remote voice is not doubled

specs.description: All system audio asks permission only for that choice
specs.given: choice is All system audio and permission is not granted
specs.then: System Audio Recording permission is requested

specs.description: Device unplugged mid-recording keeps the mic recording with a message
specs.given: recording with choice 'BlackHole 2ch'
specs.then: the microphone keeps recording, the recording does not stop, and a visible message says call audio is not being recorded

specs.description: Device missing at Record leaves mic recording with a message
specs.given: the chosen device 'Loopback' is not present
specs.then: recording starts with the microphone only and a visible message says call audio is not being recorded

specs.description: No fallback to another device
specs.given: the chosen device is missing while other inputs (e.g. 'MacBook Mic', 'BlackHole 2ch') are present
specs.when: Record is pressed or the device is unplugged
specs.then: no other device or All system audio is captured in its place and the stored choice is not changed

specs.description: A missing device never stops or fails the recording
specs.given: any chosen device and any moment (before Record or during recording) at which it is absent
specs.then: the microphone recording continues, the output WAV contains the mic audio, and the not-recorded message is shown

specs.description: Stored 'One app' reads as None
specs.given: a stored call-audio setting of 'One app' from the first build, with an app selected
specs.then: the choice is None and no app is captured

specs.description: Old 'One app' setting does not produce a permission row or capture
specs.given: a stored 'One app' choice
specs.when: the Recording card is shown and Record is pressed
specs.then: no permission row appears for it, and only the microphone is recorded

specs.description: Any stored value that is the legacy app choice reads as None, other values are unchanged
specs.given: any stored value: 'One app' with any app identifier, or None, All system audio, or a device id
specs.then: 'One app' values (any app) read as None; every other value reads back as stored

specs.description: Device source and tap are interchangeable behind the CallAudioTap port
specs.given: a fake device adapter and a fake tap adapter, both implementing CallAudioTap
specs.then: the mixing and choice logic work identically with either adapter and need no knowledge of which one is used

specs.description: The choice and mix do not depend on capture frameworks
specs.given: the pure choice and mix functions
specs.when: they are run in a test with no AVCaptureDevice, no tap and no OS access
specs.then: they produce results from plain inputs alone; only the adapters touch the OS
